# turingpi Provider

The Turing Pi provider allows you to manage Turing Pi 2 cluster board resources.

## Features

- **Flash OS images** to compute modules (supports URL download with auto-decompression)
- **Power management** for individual nodes
- **USB configuration** for node connectivity
- **BMC information** retrieval

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    turingpi = {
      source  = "davidroman0O/turingpi"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "turingpi" {
  host     = var.bmc_host
  username = var.bmc_username
  password = var.bmc_password
}

variable "bmc_host" {
  description = "Turing Pi 2 BMC hostname or IP address."
  type        = string
}

variable "bmc_username" {
  description = "Turing Pi 2 BMC username."
  type        = string
  default     = "root"
}

variable "bmc_password" {
  description = "Turing Pi 2 BMC password."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) BMC hostname or IP address. Can also be set via `TURINGPI_HOST` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) BMC password for authentication. Can also be set via `TURINGPI_PASSWORD` environment variable. Default: `turing`
- `ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password for BMC file operations (used for BMC caching). Defaults to `password` if not set.
- `ssh_port` (Number) SSH port for BMC file operations. Default: `22`
- `ssh_user` (String) SSH username for BMC file operations (used for BMC caching). Defaults to `username` if not set.
- `username` (String) BMC username for authentication. Can also be set via `TURINGPI_USERNAME` environment variable. Default: `root`
